title: Settings page
description: A full settings page — hc-shell app frame around an account-settings card of hc-fields with hints, a mutating-form submit, field-error distribution on 422, and a success toast.
---

import SettingsTemplateDemo from '../../../components/template-demos/SettingsTemplateDemo.astro';

An [`hc-shell`](/hypermedia-components/components/shell/) app frame —
header, sidebar navigation, scrolling main — whose main region is the
[account-settings block](/hypermedia-components/blocks/) wired up for
real: an [`hc-card`](/hypermedia-components/components/card/) form of
[`hc-field`](/hypermedia-components/components/field/) rows with
persistent hints, submitting the
[mutating-form](/hypermedia-components/recipes/mutating-form/) way. A
422 distributes the server's
[field-errors fragment](/hypermedia-components/recipes/field-errors/) to
the fields it names; success raises a
[toast](/hypermedia-components/recipes/toast/).

## Live template

Try all three branches: submit with a **blank email** (the `required`
error lands under the Email field), with **`taken@example.com`** (the
`duplicate` error), and with any other email (a **"Member saved"**
toast — the empty 200 body clears the error summary).

The demo form posts to `api/recipes/field-errors/members`, whose
contract — 422 + fragment on failure, 200 + `hc:toast` on success —
keeps the whole round trip on this page. The
[mutating-form contract's](/hypermedia-components/recipes/mutating-form/)
own success branch is a **redirect** (`HX-Redirect`, a full window
navigation) — its recipe page demos that; a settings page that stays
put on save uses exactly the toast variant shown here.

<SettingsTemplateDemo />

## Page skeleton

The complete page, with real-app-shaped URLs (`/settings/profile` —
swap in your own endpoint). No toast markup is needed:
`installToast()` creates its own region.

```html
<body>
  <div class="hc-shell">
    <header class="hc-shell__header">
      <button class="hc-button hc-shell__toggle" data-variant="ghost"
              data-hc-shell-toggle aria-label="Open navigation" type="button">≡</button>
      <strong>Acme Admin</strong>
    </header>

    <nav class="hc-shell__sidebar" aria-label="Primary">
      <a href="/dashboard">Dashboard</a>
      <a href="/members">Members</a>
      <a href="/settings" aria-current="page">Settings</a>
    </nav>

    <main class="hc-shell__main">
      <!-- method/action keep the no-JS submit working (post/redirect/get). -->
      <form class="hc-card" style="max-inline-size: 34rem;"
            method="post" action="/settings/profile"
            data-hx-post="/settings/profile"
            data-hx-target="#settings-errors"
            data-hx-swap="innerHTML"
            data-hx-disabled-elt="find button[type=submit]"
            data-hx-indicator="find .hc-spinner">
        <div class="hc-card__header"><strong>Account settings</strong></div>

        <div class="hc-card__body hc-stack" style="--hc-stack-gap: 1rem;">
          <!-- The 422 field-errors fragment swaps in here; installFieldErrors
               distributes each item to the field it names. -->
          <div id="settings-errors"></div>

          <div class="hc-field">
            <label class="hc-field__label" for="settings-email">Email</label>
            <input class="hc-input" id="settings-email" name="email" type="email"
                   aria-describedby="settings-email-hint" />
            <!-- __hint stays muted even when the field is invalid. -->
            <p class="hc-field__hint" id="settings-email-hint">
              Used for sign-in and notifications — we never share it.
            </p>
            <p class="hc-field__error" aria-live="polite"></p>
          </div>

          <div class="hc-field">
            <label class="hc-field__label" for="settings-display-name">Display name</label>
            <input class="hc-input" id="settings-display-name" name="display_name" type="text"
                   aria-describedby="settings-display-name-hint" />
            <p class="hc-field__hint" id="settings-display-name-hint">
              Shown to the rest of your team.
            </p>
          </div>

          <label class="hc-switch-label">
            <input class="hc-switch" name="notify" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked />
            Email notifications
          </label>
        </div>

        <div class="hc-card__footer hc-cluster"
             style="--hc-cluster-gap: 0.5rem; justify-content: flex-end;">
          <span class="hc-spinner htmx-indicator" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <button class="hc-button" data-variant="primary" type="submit">Save changes</button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
```

## Wiring map

| Region | Component / block | Recipe | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| App frame | [`hc-shell`](/hypermedia-components/components/shell/) | — | — (pure CSS; `installShell()` powers mobile nav) |
| Settings card | [`hc-card`](/hypermedia-components/components/card/) + [account-settings block](/hypermedia-components/blocks/) | [mutating-form](/hypermedia-components/recipes/mutating-form/) | [`mutating-form/contract.md`](https://github.com/ingcreators/hypermedia-components/blob/main/recipes/mutating-form/contract.md) |
| Fields + hints | [`hc-field`](/hypermedia-components/components/field/) + [`hc-input`](/hypermedia-components/components/input/) | — | — |
| Error summary + distribution | [`hc-alert`](/hypermedia-components/components/alert/) | [field-errors](/hypermedia-components/recipes/field-errors/) | [`field-errors/contract.md`](https://github.com/ingcreators/hypermedia-components/blob/main/recipes/field-errors/contract.md) |
| Success toast | [`hc-toast`](/hypermedia-components/components/toast/) | [toast](/hypermedia-components/recipes/toast/) | [`toast/contract.md`](https://github.com/ingcreators/hypermedia-components/blob/main/recipes/toast/contract.md) |

## Adapt it

- **Rename the endpoints.** `/settings/profile` is a placeholder — the
  server just has to implement the
  [mutating-form](/hypermedia-components/recipes/mutating-form/) /
  [field-errors](/hypermedia-components/recipes/field-errors/)
  contracts (422 + fragment, success + toast or `HX-Redirect`).
- **Real CSRF.** Add `<meta name="csrf-token">` and `installCsrfHeader()`
  for the htmx path, plus your framework's hidden field for the no-JS
  form — see [CSRF tokens](/hypermedia-components/integrations/htmx/#csrf-tokens--the-blessed-convention).
- **Real auth.** The demo API is anonymous; gate your endpoint with
  your framework's session auth — the
  [server integration guides](/hypermedia-components/integrations/)
  show the idioms per stack.
- **Error copy.** Keep messages human — see the
  [writing guide](/hypermedia-components/fundamentals/writing/).
